notes.title: Radar Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I released a small patch to fix a bug that occurred when the player saved the game while the radar was zoomed out. After loading the game, the radar remained zoomed in and could not be zoomed out anymore.

Big thanks to the players irnnn and Shved for pointing that out. ːsteamthumbsupː

The patch will be automatically applied the next time you restart Steam. The fix will work on saves where the bug has not occurred and will prevent it from happening again for new players who start the game.
